changeSet.author: cashbee
changeSet.comment: Fix PAID cashbacks with NULL paid_batch_id by matching to correct batch via paid_at timestamp (within 5 min of batch completed_at) and user_id.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE cashback c INNER JOIN ( SELECT c2.id AS cashback_id, bti.batch_id AS matched_batch_id FROM cashback c2 INNER JOIN batch_transfer_item bti ON bti.user_id = c2.user_id INNER JOIN batch_transfer_export bte ON bte.id = bti.batch_id WHERE c2.status = 'PAID' AND c2.paid_batch_id IS NULL AND c2.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND bte.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND c2.paid_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(bte.completed_at, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AND DATE_ADD(bte.completed_at, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) ) matched ON matched.cashback_id = c.id SET c.paid_batch_id = matched.matched_batch_id, c.updated_at = NOW()
